description: This file defines the AppDbContext class for Entity Framework Core, representing the database context for the application. It includes DbSet properties for various entities like Documents, Users, Contacts, Projects, and more, as well as custom configuration in OnModelCreating and a method to update user login timestamps.

classes.name: AppDbContext
classes.description: The Entity Framework Core database context class for the application, managing entity configurations and database sets.

methods.name: UpdateLastLoginAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates the LastLoginAt and UpdatedAt timestamps for a user identified by userId.
